# Affitor Documentation

> Documentation for Affitor affiliate programs, tracking, commissions, and payouts.

## Start here

- [Agent integration runbook](https://affitor.com/docs/skill.md): Integrate tracking and verify it end-to-end.
- [Complete documentation](https://affitor.com/docs/llms-full.txt): Every documentation page, blog post, and changelog entry, with page identifiers and source metadata.
- [Sitemap](https://affitor.com/sitemap.xml): Every public page on affitor.com, including the docs and the blog.

## Documentation sections

- [API Reference](https://affitor.com/docs/api-reference/overview.md): Base URL, authentication, request/response envelope, and available endpoints for the Affitor Tracking API.
- [Launch Your Program](https://affitor.com/docs/brand/quickstart.md): Set up your Affitor affiliate program in 20–30 minutes: account, program details, commissions, partner approval, and payouts — $0/month, free until your program's first $10,000 in affiliate revenue.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://affitor.com/docs/faq.md): Common questions about Affitor's pricing, tracking, commissions, and integration options.
- [Getting Started](https://affitor.com/docs/getting-started.md): Start here as an advertiser: what Affitor is, how click-to-payout tracking works, and the performance pricing — $0/month, 3.5% only after each program's first $10,000 in affiliate revenue.
- [What is Affitor?](https://affitor.com/docs/index.md): Affitor is an affiliate growth platform for SaaS: $0/month with a 3.5% fee only after each program's first $10,000 in affiliate revenue, Stripe-native attribution, and an integration an AI agent can complete and verify.
- [Become a Partner](https://affitor.com/docs/partners.md): Join a SaaS affiliate program on Affitor, get your referral link, and start earning commission.
- [Support](https://affitor.com/docs/support.md): Get help with Affitor, follow the fastest self-serve path, and know when to contact the team.

## Blog and changelog

- [Blog](https://affitor.com/blog): The canonical blog home. All posts are included in the complete documentation above.
- [Changelog](https://affitor.com/changelog.md): Every changelog entry, newest first, with open deprecations on top. Each entry also has its own twin at its URL + .md.
- [Changelog JSON](https://affitor.com/changelog.json): Every entry as data (points, learn-more link, media files, AI context), newest first, with the brand kit.
- [Changelog context for AI](https://affitor.com/changelog/context.md): Brand, facts that hold everywhere and what never to say, for AI-made posts and videos.
